author: justorian
body:
Hello there,
I feel my Avicus Ban was completely unfair as I haven't done anything. I do have some backstory, but I doubt it means anything. So, let me begin.
  • CuriousJuly
  • http://prntscr.com/73mkag
  • Well, for starters, this may sound absurd and stereotypical, but I didn't do anything. And I swear, I have not done ANYTHING. I haven't even been on Avicus Network for a month now. The last time I played any server was yesterday. I started playing at 6:00 PM EST, and then my Minecraft started going weird and I kept getting kicked from like, every server, for "Too many packets," just to end of this nonsense my programs all shut down and I couldn't do anything but lag on my laptop like crazy. This just infuriates me, because when I wake up this morning from yesterday's news, I just find that I was banned for Hack-Killing. Again, I haven't been on Avicus Network for about a month now. Last time I played was with my friend, 'Branno557' and that is the only reason I even play on this darn server. He is the only reason I am appealing right now. Because I want to continue to enjoy a good time on a good server. With unique minigames. So, what now? What if my sister logs on in the future? Her in-game name is 'SweetTarts1,' and I doubt she will play on Avicus Network, but will she be banned if she does play on the server? So, if you could at least hand me some proof of any hacking, because I can't believe that I would do such nonsense. This has already happened to me twice on another server. And it's ridiculous that it's happening now. I've beraly got a hold of my PC right now, but I think someone is getting into my account, so I'm changing my password. I hope this was a mistake, because if not, it's a joke. 

    Anyways, that's all I have to say because I'm speechless. I'm so confused and upset and worried and furious. I'm a mess right now, so fix it. I'm not going home without a good reason, and some proof, because I DID NOT HACK.
    Have a good day.
    ~CuriousJuly
